author: Trip.com Member
text: Everything about this hotel was great. I especially loved the breakfast — it was delicious and a perfect start to the day. A huge thank you to the super friendly staff who made me feel so welcome. The location is also a major plus, as it’s close to everything. I will definitely be back!

author: joules w
text: Possibly the best hotel I've ever been to. Super friendly and helpful staff, and seriously the best breakfast buffet full of fresh fruit and juices, eggs, sausages, pastries and even sushi. There is a big gym, nature trails with free roaming tortoises, and a few delicious restaurants as well. Love the old sitting rooms too. Couldn't be happier.

author: Megan Skye
text: It was such an incredible experience. The mountains are gorgeous. The gardens are beautiful. The staff is incredibly friendly and professional. The outside restaurant for breakfast and lunch has the most beautiful Mountain views. The food is delicious. The breakfast buffet is the best breakfast selection I’ve seen and tasted, I’ve travelled all over the world and nothing beats Vineyard hotel. The beds are so comfy. The gym is luxurious and quiet with the most beautiful Mountain View’s. Our room view was beautiful too. I loved everything about this place. I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend.

author: Meera Hoosen
text: Beautiful afternoon high tea at the Vineyard Hotel with friends. The setting is peaceful and scenic, with magnificent mountain views and well-kept gardens that make you slow down and appreciate the surroundings. The high tea was enjoyable, the scones were fresh, and the atmosphere relaxed and welcoming. Service was attentive without being intrusive. One of the highlights was seeing the resident tortoise quietly moving through the gardens — such a lovely unexpected moment. A very pleasant Cape Town experience overall.”

author: L O
text: Dropped in for Breakfast, Now I've had the pleasure to visit Hotels & Restaurants from all around the world and this place was such a refreshing surprise. The quality and combination of food for Brunch was exceptional, the staff was unmatched in their attentiveness and friendliness. Totally mind blown, what an excellent spot, Will be coming back soon. Thank You All 😇🙌🏼

author: Jayesh Tailor
text: The Vineyard, is rated as a 4star Hotel but I rate The Vineyard as a 5 Star. I have stayed at The Vineyard many times, sometimes two or three times a year. Most hotels have comfortable beds, showers, baths, tv, kettle, iron, swimming pool, gym etc etc. However what other hotels do not have is the exceptional and wonderful staff that The Vineyard has. Each and every staff member goes above and beyond to deliver exceptional service and care for all visitors to the hotel not just the guests. The staff are hard working, attentive, helpful, forward thinking, caring, understanding. During my work or my travels if things go wrong, yes I will complain but if my complaint is due to bad service then I always blame management for not providing adequate training and for The Vineyard I compliment not only staff but the management also, for getting the training of their staff to such a perfection. We had the pleasure of being served at the restaurants by many people but one person will always be in my memory. Trust, one of the waiters in the courtyard restaurant, we were a group of 7, Trust was perfect in his service and care for all the guests. What stood out about Trust was that 10 minutes or so after we all left the table, I went back to my room and I received a phone call, I did not hear very well, but I heard something like “on the table” and I said to Trust “ I will come down” I figured that I may have left my my hand sanitiser on the table. When I got to the restaurant Trust came out from the kitchen holding some money, “sir you left this on the table” I had completely forgotten I had left 400Rand on the table! It would be totally understandable if Trust had thought this was an additional tip and 99% people would think that but not Trust he called to tell me and safely kept the money until I came down. 400Rand is not a lot of money in the grand scheme of things but it is the principal which Trust adheres to, honesty and he lives by his name, Trust! Thank You Trust Thank You The Vineyard. See you again soon

author: Fazlyn Petersen
text: The ambience and scenery at the restaurant was lovely. The desserts looked beautiful but I didn't enjoy them. My sundae had liquid at the bottom when it arrived at my table. It wasn't very hot so I didn't expect it to be melted when it arrived. I was told that it happens. I asked them replaced it with cheesecake. The cheesecake was more yellow than expected and average. My friend's carrot cake and scones were more enjoyable.

author: Cece Kearns
text: Had such a lovely lunch at The Vineyard Hotel. The setting is absolutely beautiful, with peaceful gardens and stunning mountain views that make the whole experience feel so relaxing. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and the service was warm and attentive throughout. The atmosphere was calm, elegant, and perfect for a lunch date. Definitely one of those places that makes you want to come back again. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a beautiful lunch spot in Cape Town.

author: holly kidd
text: I recently stayed at The Vineyard for my 40th bday weekend. I was drawn to it from the gorgeous photos of the garden on the website. It did not disappoint. The hotel was such a welcoming, uber lush and comfortable place for my first visit to South Africa. Walking around the gardens under the table mountain, after a lavish breakfast, and meeting some resident tortoises was a highlight. Would have loved a swim if the weather had been warmer or a sauna if there was one. I particularly loved the Holly tree, see if you can find it :) The staff went extra miles and were happy to serve our requests. Thanks for the special memories.

author: Thais
text: It was a very pleasant experience staying at this hotel. It’s in a perfect location to experience the vibrant Cape Town Waterfront, surrounded by excellent places to eat, drink, and shop. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, with good mountain and harbor views if you choose the Mountain Facing rooms. We found the staff at reception, the restaurant, and the valet parking to be particularly friendly. They have a beautifully designed restaurant with a wonderful terrace for enjoying breakfast. If I had to find a fault, I didn’t quite understand the breakfast included with extras for basic items like coffee and eggs, but it doesn’t represent an exorbitant cost. You can enjoy the pool, spa, and gym at the nearby Queen Victoria Hotel. In short, a very good option for accommodation in this charming city.

author: Trip.com Member
text: The duty Manager, Victoria, was great and very accommodating. It was our wedding anniversary and Victoria accommodated our request for a view facing Table Mountain. We were very happy about that. The housekeeping staff were brilliant, always smiling and joyful to all guests making them feel welcome. In terms of the restaurant/breakfast area, it was quite disappointing as we noticed some guests receiving more attention than others, and at times, felt as though we were ignored and invisible. Unfortunately, on our last day, we bit into a sharp and hard piece of what seemed like bottle plastic in the food from the buffet section. When alerting the restaurant staff, they did not really seem bothered about the danger it had should we have swallowed it.

author: Trek28439570452
text: Totally recommended; great service, a peaceful atmosphere, and exceptionally helpful staff throughout the hotel. The in-house restaurant, Ginja, was outstanding, offering both excellent quality and a wide variety of yummy food, matched by warm and attentive service.||A special shout-out to Ayah, who truly made our experience memorable. As our server, he went above and beyond to make our group feel completely at home. Every request was handled quickly and thoughtfully, often improved by his suggestions and genuine kindness. Everyone at our table was commenting on how fantastic he was and how tasty the food was. ||We will definitely be returning to this hotel in the future!

author: 603janetv
text: Fabulous hotel that has managed to maintain the charm of a bygone era with a modern, crisp and comfortable atmosphere. The staff are friendly and accommodating. The food is excellent!! Breakfast consists of a bountiful spread and ala carte is also available. Overlooking Table Mountain, the views from the restaurant are breathtaking. With sufficient indoor and outdoor seating there are enough spots to choose from.

author: Stephanie Brumbaugh
text: We absolutely loved our stay at the Victoria & Alfred Hotel in Cape Town! The location is fantastic and made it so easy to explore the area on foot. Being able to walk to so many shops, restaurants, and attractions was such a huge plus. The views from the hotel are incredible and made every moment feel special. Waking up to that scenery each day was unforgettable. The breakfast was also top tier - delicious, plentiful, and the perfect way to start the day. Everything about our stay was wonderful, and we’re already looking forward to coming back. Highly recommend!

author: lynnpS6421FD
text: We have just left this large but cosy hotel. We had a loft room on the 3rd floor which was unusual, clean, warm, had everything you needed. The sloping windows are a feature but I would have liked to be able to see more out of them - they have narrow shutters. But that was my only complaint. |The staff were helpful and pleasant, food in the restaurant was reasonably priced and well presented. |Breakfast was a pleasure too. |The waterfront location is fantastic, you really should stay here.

author: Kayla Thomas
text: We stayed here during our honeymoon (September 2025), and everything about our experience was absolutely wonderful! The hotel is beautiful, and the staff were some of the friendliest and kindest people we met on our trip. I wish I could remember the names of our breakfast servers because they were all so amazing and welcoming each morning. The buffet and hot breakfast (and the coffee!) were SO good—definitely one of the highlights of our stay. We also had dinner at the hotel restaurant one night, and it was honestly one of the best steaks I’ve ever had. Every meal felt special and perfectly prepared. The location couldn’t have been better—it’s right on the waterfront, within easy walking distance to shops, restaurants, and the main area where you can catch the hop-on hop-off bus. Our room was huge, spotless, and surprisingly quiet despite facing the main waterfront area. We were also greeted with a bottle of sparkling wine and chocolates, which was such a thoughtful and sweet touch. Everything about this hotel exceeded our expectations. It was the perfect place to stay in Cape Town, and we’d absolutely stay here again in a heartbeat!

author: MsG_13
text: This was the first stop on a much longer holiday for me. The hotel is in a great location, with shopping and eateries all round. ||Our room was big, very clean and comfortable with everything you would expect to have in the room. Our room overlooked the shopping side and was a bit noisy sometimes, but we were out a lot so this wasn't something we would have requested a room change for.||We had breakfast every morning at the dockside with fantastic views of Table Mountain. We also had dinner there once as enjoyed the food.||Also a good location for tour pickups. We walked to get the ferry for Robben Island.

author: Andy Meighen
text: Well you could not get any more central than this. Right on the waterfront. Rooms were fine. I liked the big pillows, but the mattress was quite bouncy! Service was great and breakfast choices excellent. We stayed four nights and two mornings the cooked breakfasts took a long time. The other two were quick. It was a bit of pot luck

author: Andrew Morgan
text: A perfect choice overlooking the harbour and a stunning view of table top mountain from the restaurant and patio. Ideal position to explore Cape Town and the great restaurants and tourist attractions etc in the V&A waterfront area. Lovey breakfast and staff. Large chic studio room. Would recommend Table Top mountain visit on the tour bus, Robben Island Tour and The Cape Peninsula Tour. We loved Cape Town.

author: Shawn Page
text: Our stay at Nsala was fantastic. From the moment we arrived we encountered tons of animals. Our guide Sunday was exceptional and gave us some incredible experiences. We saw all the animals (Lions, Leopard, Rhinos, Elephants, Giraffes, etc.) and had some incredible up close encounters. The service staff was up to par with our guide and gave us delicious meals & clean spaces the entire time we were there. Matthew our host had amazing hospitality, and went the extra mile to make sure we had a great time. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a Safari in the area it does not disappoint.

author: Johnathan Page
text: I had a wonderful experience at Nsala. Our guide Sunday did an amazing job. We saw lions, wild dogs, a leopard, elephants, rhinos and so much more. The accommodations, service staff, and food were top notch. Lastly; the owner, Mathew, went above and beyond to make sure our experience was excellent. I highly recommend.

author: Milad Jokari
text: We had a wonderful stay at Nsala Wilderness Camp. The staff, Sunday, Vikie, Aron, and Girlie are truly warm and welcoming, and Cecil is a fantastic addition to the team. Every moment of our four-day stay was memorable. We were fortunate enough to spot four of the Big Five, along with many other animals. While wildlife sightings always involve luck and nothing is guaranteed, Sunday is an excellent tracker and led us to some truly spectacular wildlife encounters. Cecil’s presence also added greatly to our overall experience and enjoyment of the stay. A big thank you to the entire team, and to Matthew, for organizing such an outstanding lodge and safari experience. Regarding the camp itself, there are two daily game drives—one early in the morning at 5 and another in the afternoon at 4. In between, there is plenty of time to relax, enjoy delicious meals, and take in the beautiful surroundings. Wildlife can often be seen passing by or even through the camp. Despite occasional close encounters with hyenas, we always felt completely safe thanks to the attentive and professional staff who were always nearby. We are grateful for the experience and plan to visit Nsala again in future

author: Vasile Casco
text: We had an absolutely unforgettable stay at Nsala Wilderness Camp! 🌿 From the moment we arrived, we felt completely immersed in nature — with animals casually visiting us throughout the day. The lodge is intimate (max 10 guests), so even if it’s full, you get a personal, homey atmosphere. We were lucky enough to be the only guests during our stay, so it felt like VIP treatment from start to finish. The staff is outstanding. Sunday, our ranger, was incredibly respectful, friendly, and truly skilled — it was our very first safari and we were amazed to see all of the Big 5! Shana made us feel right at home and gave us great tips throughout our stay, while James impressed us with his amazing cooking skills. Big thanks also to everyone else who worked behind the scenes to make everything perfect. The lodge itself is comfortable and beautifully designed in true safari style — the perfect place to relax, disconnect, and soak in the wilderness. We loved the great conversations and drinks by the campfire, and enjoyed good coffee while watching the sunrise and getting ready for the impressive game drives that followed. This trip exceeded all expectations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for an intimate, authentic, and unforgettable safari experience! 🌅🦁🐘

author: Arres Oudshoorn
text: We've had a great time at this camp during our 3-day stay. The onsite staff is super friendly. Vision prepares tasty meals which were very welcome after game drives where the ranger really went the extra mile for a unique experience (saw 4/5 of the big five, including 2 up-close Leopard sightings and an up-close Rhino sighting). There is ample time to re-charge in between game drives in your room or at the swimming pool next to the wildlife that frequents the camp (such as hyenas and monkeys).

author: Suman Mampilly
text: Sunday, Aaron, and Vickie were amazing and took such good care of us the entire time we were there! Not to mention Sunday's patience and determination while we were on safari rides. Truly one of the best experiences we had in South Africa!!

author: Laura Brockie
text: We just spent 4 nights at Nsala and had an unforgettable time! Though nervous initially after reading some recent poor reviews, this was far from our experience. The lodge is beautiful, clean, and peaceful. We also never had any issues with power or internet. It was particularly lovely to sit on the deck watching zebra, warthog, and incredible bird life pass by. Vision is a fabulous chef and every meal was delicious! Our experience was made though by our fantastic and knowledgeable game driver, Shoas. He put in the extra mile and we loved his off piece expeditions to get close up to the animals. Due to some unforeseen wind our game viewings were reduced over the last couple of days, but we were so pleased with our other encounters (including 4 of the big 5, and 2 leopard sightings)! Thank you Nsala!

author: Vanessa B
text: Our stay at Nsala Wilderness Camp was incredible! The camp is beautifully integrated into the bush, offering comfort and stunning views. The staff were welcoming and knowledgeable, making every game drive an adventure—we saw lions, elephants, and even a leopard!

author: Maryke Rademeyer
text: Spent a lovely couple of nights at Nsala, where we were booked after well by the entire team there, including the resident mongoose family, monkeys and hyena. The view of the bush from the deck and the pool provided many opportunities to view elephants as they passed by the lodge, with the game drives delivering in some beautiful sightings. Thank you to everyone at Nsala for making our time there so special.

author: Patricia López Díaz
text: Nsala Camp was an absolutely lovely lodge. We had a great experience in this place thanks to our tour Sunday. He is a very experienced and nice man who shows you all the special areas where you can find animals in the Safari. We are still in contact with him, we are friends! The food was unreal very fresh and healthy! We will have an unforgettable memory of our honeymoon thanks to Sunday and all his team. Patricia Lopez Diaz y Gary Lynch

author: Julian John
text: Really awesome Hotel and conference facilities. Service is great from the Security, all the way to the entrance, front desk and catering staff. I must say the Security were so friendly and helpful, showing me where to park then escorting me to the reception. The hotel is really plush and luxurious. The food was amazing - from the pastries/snack food to the full lunch. Conference facilities were great. In fact there was no glitch at all during the entire conference. Great venue overall

author: NortonerStratford
text: We had an absolutely superb stay here. We often travel from the UK, our usual hotel was not available so we booked the Houghton.....what a great find!||We were upgraded from a studio to a city view room. The room was enormous, with everything we needed.||I had a spa treatment which was excellent. We used the indoor and outdoor pools and steam room, all of which were clean and modern. ||The food was excellent, lots of choice and beautifully cooked. We had cocktails in the bar and sat around the terrace with our sushi.||The thing that makes the hotel is the staff. From the gentleman who checks you into the car park, the waiting staff to the management, all were lovely and made us feel totally welcome. ||The hotel is safe with secure parking and shopping and restaurant areas nearby. We will definitely be back.

author: Trip.com Member
text: Nice localtion.Very friendly the staff

author: Brad Morehead
text: Great experience with the staff. Wonderful room and food and view of the city. Would definitely come back. We had a brief snafu with the reservation, but the team resolved it and everything was great. The food for dinner was excellent.

author: Lesanne Dunlop
text: I would just like to say that the Houghton hotel has one of the most outstanding customer service teams I have ever encountered. I left my phone in an uber, the driver was not getting back to me and seemingly had no intention of returning it. Their security team, specifically Gordon and Mark as well as the houghton driver, drove an hour away to a sketchy part of Johannesburg at night to retrieve my phone from this driver! I was leaving the country early the next morning so without them would not have been able to get my phone back. I just can not thank you guys enough for your efforts and real sincerity in wanting to help me. You truly went ABOVE and BEYOND! Thank you thank you thank you! 🙏 Aside from this amazing service, the rest of the team were just so wonderful the entire time we were there. The food was great, the spa was amazing, the rooms were lovely. We will MOST definitely be coming back. Thank you again guys! 🙏🙏🙏

author: Lwazi Radebe
text: Its a bit difficult to rate here because i only went there for a summit at one of their events/conference rooms. With being said, the security from the moment you enter the boom, they are very welcoming and thorough. The room was neat, good sound and visuals setup. Nothing negative to note really. The staff showing me where to go were great.

author: travelnicolle
text: We spent our final night in South Africa at The Houghton, staying in a two-bedroom penthouse with a private pool and jacuzzi. It was truly spectacular, easily the most expansive suite we have ever experienced. While the hardware of the hotel is stunning, the service is what defines the stay. From the lovely front desk and luggage team who greeted us with champagne, to the seamless hospitality after check-out, we felt completely looked after. They stored our luggage and gave us full access to the pool for the day, even providing private bathroom facilities to freshen up before our international flight. A world-class experience from start to finish.

author: Abdul Kader Mohamed
text: I recently had the opportunity to visit the Hotel for a business lunch. I was pleasantly surprised by the beauty and decor - it made me feel like, for a moment i was outside Johannesburg and in some international/cosmopolitan city. For a moment I felt like some important person, enjoying the good things in life. The food and service did not disappoint and just added to the experience. Good vibe. Good food. Good service. Real lifestyle!

author: Zeenat harper-valentine
text: Hotel and staff was absolutely stunning! My issue is with the restaurant and staff -Nova Bistro. There was a menu special - 2 course and 3 course. Offered freely last week and we thoroughly enjoyed it. I brought my sister and brother in law today and was refused this menu...citing it was incorrectly used. I booked my dining experience in advance and was thoroughly disappointed. Nobody called to inform me of this change -had they done so, I wouldn't have traveled all this way to enjoy the meal. Disappointed is an understatement and because of this...I will not return and do not endorse this restaurant. Staff are arrogant and have no idea how to put the customer first. I was then told to reserve my table on dining city...which I tried and was not allowed. The staff then informed me that the menu is now only allowed for during the week. Absolute joke...last time here for sure

author: MarkR-Sheffield
text: Our first stay at the Houghton and won’t be our last. After 24 hours of travelling with an overnight flight from the UK, we arrived tired at 9 am. Without asking, we are offered a suite as a day room until our room was ready. This gave us a chance for a couple of hours sleep and freshen up, and was genuinely highly appreciated. ||||our room was larger than expected, with a fab bathroom. ||||The lunchtime restaurant on the outside terrace presented 2 wonderful salads, but the highlight of our 2 night stay was dinner at Cyra which is worthy of a Michelin star, with some highly innovative dishes, all exquisitely presented. It is no surprise that in the 12 months it’s been open It’s won many awards for Chef Candice, who delightfully came out and introduced herself. ||||The customer service is excellent. As we were checking out and waiting for our taxi, one of their senior staff noticed my wife who was poorly that morning & immediately sat with her and ordered a coke to help settle her upset stomach. ||||As golfers, we played the Houghton course, which although we found it quite challenging being long with plenty of water hazards - most beautifully presented and I am not surprised that it is hosting the DP World Tour Joburg Open in 2026. ||||Personally, I rate this hotel very highly,

author: Avinash das
text: I recently stayed at Pavilion Hotel in Durban and unfortunately had a disappointing experience during my visit. I was allocated Room 124, which is located directly in front of the store room area. The room door lock was not functioning properly, and I was informed by the staff that the battery was down. Each time I required assistance, I had to personally go down to the reception for support. Additionally, the television and room telephone were not working during my stay, which made communication difficult. I had to contact the hotel staff through WhatsApp instead of using the in-room phone service. Another concern was the limited guest support regarding basic facilities. When I requested an iron for my clothes, security informed me that it could only be provided for 45 minutes, which was inconvenient for guests staying at the property. Overall, I found Room 124 to be uncomfortable and below the standard expected for hotel accommodation. Furthermore, the breakfast menu remained the same every day without variety, and I believe the hotel should improve both the quality of service and guest experience. Based on my personal experience, I would recommend travellers consider alternative accommodation options in Durban, such as the Royal Palm Hotel in Umhlanga, which may provide a more comfortable and professional stay. I sincerely hope Pavilion Hotel takes this feedback positively and works toward improving its customer service and room quality for future guests.

author: nushen govender
text: Had and event at this location, staff were extremely helpful, the set-up looked amazing. The outside is currently being updated but the inside was brilliant. Will definitely be back to try out the restaurant, the food and bar were both extremely inviting

author: Emmanuel, Moses Nenzou
text: The hotel has a great vibe, but I recommend skipping the breakfast option in your booking because service can be quite slow. It’s smarter to grab your meals elsewhere or order them separately. I was pleased with the location and the rooms, and I enjoyed ordering dinner. However, when it comes to breakfast, I wouldn’t choose it during my stay. The staff's professionalism leaves something to be desired; they often forget orders and don’t seem to feel any remorse or apologize for that.

author: Trip.com Member
text: We had an overnight stay, the room was spacious and comfortable, staff were friendly and accommodating. We had a wonderful experience. Thank you.

author: RaucousRob
text: Avoid this place at all costs. I am amazed that they are still open. What you see on Booking.com and TripAdvisor is the furthest from the truth!!! I was amazed at the images and booked and paid in advance for 1 night. When I arrived, the place could not be further from what they advertised. FILTHY AND COMPLETELY RUN DOWN. They used the sheet from a single bed, horizontally on a king size bed, so the entire bottom of the bed was open for me to sleep on a mattress protector. If I had not already paid the full amount, which was not cheap and none refundable 2 weeks ago I would never have stayed. I literally slept with my clother on to avoid making contact with the mattress or mattress protection. I am sure the images they have on their marketing platforms are just copied from the Internet or 40 years old because they are the exact opposite of what the reality is. Then they have the audacity to charge you R50 for parking your car in their filthy courtyard. I will never go back or recommend this place to anyone. Look at their photos and see the ones I am posting. Absolutely disgusting!

author: Sanele Mntambo
text: We truly enjoyed our stay at Pavilion Hotel and were deeply impressed by the level of service we received. From the moment we arrived, everything was warm, professional, and welcoming. The breakfast buffet was absolutely excellent fresh, well-prepared, and a perfect start to each day. A very special and sincere thank you goes to Pearl and Deshni for going above and beyond to make my wife’s birthday unforgettable. They surprised us by beautifully decorating our room at no extra cost, a gesture that touched our hearts and made the celebration incredibly special. This is what world-class service looks like thoughtful, genuine, and full of care. We will definitely return and highly recommend Pavilion Hotel to anyone looking for comfort, quality, and exceptional hospitality.

author: Riaz Ismail
text: I stayed here for two nights and unfortunately my experience was really disappointing. Before checking in, I specifically asked about the air conditioning and was assured everything was in order. When I got to my room, the aircon wasn’t working at all. I called for assistance and no one came. I called a second time and still nothing was done. I eventually had to go downstairs myself, and only then was I moved to another room, about 40 minutes after first reporting the issue. That already set the tone, but it didn’t end there. The next morning, I put the “Make Up My Room” sign on the door at 07:55am. When I returned at 23:00 that night, the room had not been cleaned or serviced at all. I informed reception, and I was told they would speak to the housekeeping manager, but the room still wasn’t cleaned and I received no follow-up. Although, someone did come knocking at my door at midnight to bring me towels. On top of that, guests were quite noisy in the hallways, which made the stay even less comfortable. Basic comfort, cleanliness, and a reasonable level of quiet are standard expectations at any hotel. Having to chase staff for assistance, deal with unresolved issues, and receive no follow-up is not acceptable. Really disappointing stay overall.
